endorsements.name: Zhongquan Li
endorsements.label: Design-Based Vulnerabilities on macOS: Oops, Not a One-Shot Fix
endorsements.description: In this presentation, the speaker will disclose several macOS design-based vulnerabilities. Compared with code-level bugs, design-based vulnerabilities are often hard to fix in a single shot. A piece of vulnerable code might only be exploitable on macOS, but the same code can exist across Apple platforms (macOS, iOS, watchOS, etc.). Read more
